dish: Cook-it-yourself okonomiyaki and yakisoba in private rooms (buta-tama)
address: 2F Hatsuse Bldg., 11-25 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka
w: Okonomiyaki house founded in 1945 in a former ryokan, where every table is a private room and you grill your own okonomiyaki and yakisoba; Savor Japan lists it among Osaka's well-established names and Osaka Metro's NiNE guide covers it as a 70-plus-year Minami institution.
